**UI Audit Report: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free**

### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized, covering full screen).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 to 1024, 45):** Contains App Icon/Title (Left), Utility Icons (Right), Window Controls (Far Right).
*   **Sidebar (0, 45 to 280, 940):** Navigation pane with vertical list of categories and tools.
*   **Main Content Area (280, 45 to 1024, 940):** Primary workspace.
    *   *Header:* "Select a location..." (Top).
    *   *Section 1: Internal Drives:* Grid of device tiles.
    *   *Section 2: Specify a Location:* Grid of target folders.
    *   *Footer Bar:* Help text (Left), CTA Button (Right).
*   **Overlay / Assistant Panel (648, 178 to 968, 422):** Floating "Solution" card positioned over the right side of the main content.
*   **Taskbar (0, 940 to 1024, 768):** Windows OS taskbar at the bottom.

### 2. TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Sidebar Header:** `Data Recovery`
*   **Sidebar Item 1:** `Hardware Disk` (Selected)
*   **Sidebar Item 2:** `SD Card`
*   **Sidebar Item 3:** `More Recovery Tools`
*   **Sidebar Section Header:** `Advanced Features`
*   **Sidebar Item 4:** `File Repair`
*   **Sidebar Item 5:** `Lost Partition Rescue`
*   **Sidebar Section Header:** `File Backup`
*   **Sidebar Item 6:** `ChronoSnap Backup`
*   **Main Heading:** `Select a location to search for lost data`
*   **Subheading 1:** `Internal drives (2)`
*   **Device Tile Text:** `Windows(C:)`, `31.15 GB/149.45 GB`
*   **Subheading 2:** `Specify a location`
*   **Location Tile 1:** `Recycle Bin`
*   **Location Tile 2:** `Desktop`
*   **Location Tile 3:** `Select Folder`
*   **Footer Text:** `Unable to find your hard drive?` (+ Info icon)
*   **Footer Button:** `Search for Lost Data`
*   **Overlay Title:** `Solution 1:`
*   **Overlay Body:** `Refresh drives.`
*   **Overlay Badge:** `1/3`
*   **Overlay Button:** `Next`
*   **System Time:** `6:13 PM`, `10/17/2026`

### 3. COLOR (Estimated Hex)
*   **App Background:** `#F0F2F5` (Light Gray-Blue)
*   **Sidebar Background:** `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Sidebar Selected Item Background:** `#E6F0FF` (Light Blue)
*   **Text Primary (Headings):** `#1F1F1F` (Near Black)
*   **Text Secondary (Labels):** `#666666` or `#555555` (Dark Gray)
*   **Text Tertiary (Metadata):** `#888888` (Gray)
*   **Accent Blue (Primary Button/Selection):** `#1677FF` (Standard Windows/App Blue)
*   **Accent Blue Hover/Light:** `#4096FF`
*   **Overlay Background:** `#1677FF` (Solid Blue Gradient base) to `#2B8AFF` (Slightly lighter top/left).
*   **Overlay Text:** `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Border Color (Tiles):** `#D9D9D9` (Light Gray)
*   **Progress Bar Fill:** `#1677FF`
*   **Progress Bar Track:** `#E8E8E8`

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Main Heading:** ~20-24px, Semi-bold (600).
*   **Subheadings (Internal drives...):** ~14-16px, Regular (400), Dark Gray.
*   **Tile Titles (Windows C:, Recycle Bin):** ~14-16px, Medium (500).
*   **Tile Metadata (Size):** ~12px, Regular (400), Gray.
*   **Sidebar Items:** ~14px, Regular (400). Selected item is slightly bolder or just colored.
*   **Button Text:** ~14px, Medium (500).
*   **Overlay Text:** ~16px (Title, Bold), ~14px (Body).

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~280px.
*   **Tile Dimensions:** ~320px width x ~110px height.
*   **Tile Padding:** ~16px internal padding.
*   **Icon Size (Sidebar/Tiles):** 24x24px or 32x32px.
*   **Gutter (Grid):** ~24px between tiles.
*   **Section Spacing:** ~40px between "Internal drives" and "Specify a location".
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Tiles: ~8px.
    *   Buttons: ~4px or ~6px.
    *   Overlay Panel: ~8px.
*   **Stroke Width (Borders):** 1px.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Sidebar List:**
    *   `Hardware Disk`: **State: Selected** (Blue background, blue text/icon, green checkmark badge on right).
    *   `SD Card`: **State: Normal**.
    *   `More Recovery Tools`: **State: Normal**.
*   **Device Tiles:**
    *   `Windows(C:)`: **State: Selected/Focused** (Blue border, Blue checkmark circle icon in top-right corner).
    *   (Second Drive Tile - partially obscured): **State: Normal**.
*   **Location Tiles (`Recycle Bin`, `Desktop`, `Select Folder`):** **State: Normal** (Hoverable implied).
*   **Buttons:**
    *   `Search for Lost Data`: **State: Normal** (Primary Button style: Blue background, White text).
    *   `Next` (in Overlay): **State: Normal** (Secondary style on blue bg: White background, Blue text).
*   **Overlay Close ('X'):** Top-right of blue panel.
*   **Info Icon:** Circle with 'i', next to footer text.

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Primarily **Filled** (Solid) with some **Outline** variants for specific actions or states.
*   **Grid:** Standard 24px grid.
*   **Specifics:**
    *   Sidebar icons: Filled (Disk stack, SD card, Tools wrench, Folder with tool, Partition chart, Backup arrows).
    *   Tile Icons: Large Filled (Windows Logo on disk, Recycle Bin, Monitor/Desktop, Folder).
    *   Selection Indicator: Outline Checkmark inside solid circle.
    *   Overlay Character: 3D/Cartoon Robot mascot ("EaseUS Bot"?).
    *   Title Bar Icons: Outline (Cloud, Cart, Bell, Menu).

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Initial / Selection Required**. The user is at the first step of the wizard ("Select a location"). No scanning has started.
*   **Contextual State:** An **AI Assistant / Tip Overlay** is active ("Solution 1: Refresh drives"), suggesting the app is offering help or guidance proactively (Step 1 of 3).
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot), but the overlay implies a "wizard" progression.
